item.title: How to Create a Bidirectional File Sync using Unison
item.description:
So if you came here I consider you already have a problem to solve, and you are familiar with unison. If this is the case, skip the introduction please.

If you don’t, then keep reading as it might clarify a few things before we get started with the how to use unison in order to create a bidirectional (two way) synchronization of two directories.

Introduction

To simplify the understanding let’s imagine that you have two folders and you want both folders to be synchronized when an event happens such as a new file is created, a file got changed or even a file got deleted. You want both folders to reflect exactly the same state as a replica.

item.title: Getting to Know and Installing the SAMBA server on LINUX
item.description:
WHAT IS IT?

SAMBA is a server and a set of tools that lets Linux and Windows machines communicate with each other, sharing services (files, directories, printing) through the SMB (Server Message Block)/CIFS (Common Internet File System) protocol, equivalent to the NetBEUI implementation on Windows.

It can also be used as a primary domain controller (PDC), serving as an authentication server for Windows clients.

In most cases, access control and directory display in samba are more detailed and customizable than in Microsoft’s own system.

item.title: How to install the nVidia video driver on Ubuntu 10.04
item.description:
Assuming you’ve already downloaded the latest driver version directly from the manufacturer’s website:

http://www.nvidia.com.br/Download/index.aspx?lang=br

We can continue then…

  1. Removing other drivers and installing the recent NVIDIA driver version

Hello folks, as many nvidia graphics card users may have noticed, Compiz graphics performance and OpenGL playback are very slow in this new version of Ubuntu. To explain quickly, this is due to two factors:

  • Ubuntu 10.04 comes with a generic driver called Nouveau, so even if you install the nvidia driver provided by canonical, Nouveau will keep running.
  • The nvidia driver provided by canonical is very outdated compared to the one provided by nvidia.

So before anything else, we need to remove all video drivers installed on Ubuntu, until all of them are removed, when you try to install the recent nvidia driver, you’ll encounter the following problem:
